hits.title: StagingPro by Vortex IQ
hits.summary: True-replica staging for BigCommerce. Test, deploy and roll back safely. Multi-storefront, complex catalogues, B2B and V2 to V3 supported.
hits.searchKeywords: deployment, deployment automation, v2 to v3, migrations
hits.description: Clone, collaborate and deploy like a pro. StagingPro creates a true replica of your BigCommerce store, the same data and the same theme, so your team can build, test, and review every change before it goes live. Now with V2 to V3 migration support. Part of Vortex IQ. Who it is for Agencies: Run multiple client projects and ship faster, with shorter development and deployment cycles. Store owners: Test on staging, deploy with one-click rollback through RollbackPro, and work as a team. Developers and designers: Your own branch, your own staging site, your own codebase. What you get Accurate replica: A staging site with the same data and theme as production. Easy to use: Launch and manage environments from a simple web interface in your BigCommerce control panel. Flexible setup: Fully auditable, with rollback, and scales as your team grows. Well integrated: Works with GitHub, Atlassian Jira, Slack, and Microsoft Teams. Built for scale: Multi-storefront, complex catalogues, and a B2B edition supported. Automated: Docker-based environments that spin up quickly as part of your development cycle. Deploy with confidence Each staging site gets its own GitHub branch. Clone all your data and design, or select only what you need, and anonymise customer data for safe testing. Code review and validation help ensure only clean code reaches your live store, and every deployment can trigger notifications in GitHub, email, Slack, or Microsoft Teams. Part of Vortex IQ StagingPro is part of Vortex IQ, the AI operating system for your store. The same connection that runs your staging also watches your store, tells you what is wrong and why, and helps you fix it. Just ask Viq. And when you deploy, RollbackPro keeps a one-click safety net, so nothing touches live revenue untested. One subscription. Full access across apps. No duplicate app charges.

hits.title: Store Link
hits.summary: Store Link copies data between BigCommerce stores.
featuresList: Skip or Overwrite, and Re-Run Any Time
hits.description: The missing link between production and everywhere else. Store Link copies data from one BigCommerce store to another, so your dev, staging, and sandbox environments mirror production instead of running on guesswork. Push products, customers, orders, content, themes, and settings in a few steps — then re-run it whenever your stores drift out of sync. You decide exactly what moves, with advanced filters for applicable resources. And when a test cycle wraps, reset the store with the built-in Delete tool — no manual cleanup required. Built and maintained by BigCommerce, Store Link is the secure, first-party way to move data between your own stores. Who it's for Developers & agencies: Maintain test environments with production level data. Store owners: Keep your sandbox in lockstep with your live store, and refresh it the moment you need to. Teams launching a new store: Seed a new store or storefront from an existing one, without rebuilding it from scratch. B2B data is not supported today. This app is built and managed by BigCommerce.

hits.title: Custom Field Populator - Bulk Edit, Automate & Clean Up Custom Fields
hits.summary: Create, edit, bulk update, automate and clean up BigCommerce product custom fields from one easy-to-use app.
hits.description: BigCommerce custom fields are incredibly useful, but managing them across hundreds or thousands of products can quickly become a time-consuming mess. Custom Field Populator gives you one place to create, edit, bulk update, automate, import, export and clean up custom fields across your entire BigCommerce catalog. Instead of opening products one at a time, working through complicated spreadsheets, or trying to remember which products need which fields, Custom Field Populator lets you manage everything from an easy-to-use app right inside your BigCommerce control panel. Edit Custom Fields Right on Your Products Browse your catalog and edit custom fields directly from the Product Fields Editor. Update one product or select multiple products and make changes in bulk. Advanced filters let you quickly find products by category, price, inventory status and other criteria, making it easy to target exactly the products you need. Automatically Add the Right Fields to the Right Products Create Custom Field Rules that automatically apply fields to products based on conditions you define. Use rules to add fields to all products, specific categories, products matching certain conditions, or new products as they're added to your catalog. Once the rules are set, Custom Field Populator does the repetitive work for you. Import and Export Custom Fields in Bulk Need to make large changes in a spreadsheet? Import custom fields using CSV files and match products by SKU or BigCommerce Product ID. Custom Field Populator can also create new custom fields automatically when they're included in an import. Export your existing custom field data whenever you need to review it, edit it externally, or share it with another system. Schedule Custom Field Updates Automate recurring updates by scheduling custom field imports or rule-based changes to run daily, weekly or monthly. Imports can come from an uploaded file, URL or Google Sheet. You can even schedule temporary changes and set a revert time, making it easy to add promotional messages or field values for a sale and automatically restore the original values when the promotion ends. Restore Changes with Snapshots Custom Field Populator automatically creates Snapshots before bulk changes, imports and scheduled updates. If something doesn't look right, restore the previous custom field values with a click instead of trying to recreate them manually. Clean Up Messy Custom Field Data Custom fields have a way of getting messy over time, especially when multiple employees, imports or integrations are involved. Custom Field Populator Premium includes Custom Field Clean Up, which scans your catalog for problems such as: Duplicate custom fields Case mismatches such as "Color" and "color" Similar or repeated fields Empty custom field values Clean Up helps you identify and fix those problems, while cleanup rules help prevent them from coming back. Find & Replace Across Your Catalog Need to correct a value that's used across hundreds of products? Premium's Find & Replace tool lets you change custom field values throughout your catalog at once without exporting, editing and re-importing a spreadsheet. Keep an Eye on Custom Field Health Premium users can receive a weekly Custom Field Health Report highlighting newly detected field issues, helping you catch inconsistencies before they spread across your catalog. See What's Happening The Tasks tray shows live progress while imports, exports and other jobs are running, while the Activity page keeps a history of changes so you can see what happened, when it happened and who made the change. Whether you have a few dozen products or a catalog with thousands of SKUs, Custom Field Populator helps you spend less time managing custom fields and more time managing your store.

hits.title: V2 to V3 Product Review & Upgrade Service by Your Store Wizards
hits.summary: Full-service V2 to V3 review and upgrade service done by a developer for those considering upgrading to Products V3.
featuresList: What You Get With Our Review Service
What We Check For During the Review

Developer and Client Communication Every Step of the Way
hits.description: Worried about upgrading from V2 to V3 yourself? Let's talk! Purchase your V2 to V3 Upgrade Review, then schedule time with us to go over it and learn everything you need to know before upgrading yourself or with our NO DOWNTIME upgrade service. $299 fee to review your current products, variants, rules, modifiers and run a simulated upgrade. Full report on what will change with your products if you upgrade to V3. Scheduled Zoom call to review our findings in depth and answer any question regarding upgrading. Cost of review is applied to our full, white-glove upgrade service with zero downtime! Many store owners are unaware of the complexities involved in upgrading from V2 to V3 in BigCommerce, or are hesitant to use a self-service app, or attempt to do the upgrade themselves. If that sounds familiar, we offer an affordable, full-service solution that takes the guesswork (and stress) out of upgrading. The first step of the process involves a complete review of your product data, which includes variants, rules, modifiers, and more. Using our proprietary software, we'll run a simulated upgrade on your items, which allows us to identify any items that don't fit the v3 structure and will suggest necessary changes that must be made prior to the actual upgrade. We'll provide you with a complete list of any options or SKUs that will be lost during the upgrade—especially hidden or disabled choices. We'll also highlight any items that won't function properly after the upgrade, and outlining what we can handle automatically if you choose us for the upgrade. Once our analysis is complete, we'll schedule a one-on-one Zoom meeting to go over your results, answer questions, and ensure you're fully prepared for the transition. If you're considering upgrading to V3, take the first step by installing our V2 to V3 migration app to schedule your $299 review. The cost of the review is credited towards the full migration, should you choose to proceed. It's important to note that our app does not perform any upgrades or data analysis, it allows us access to your store for the review, and by installing you agree to the $299 review fee. Our V2 to V3 upgrade service is recommended by BigCommerce in their support documentation: https://support.bigcommerce.com/s/article/Products-V3-Migration?language=en\\\_US

consentPreferenceCenter.title: Privacy Preference Center
consentPreferenceCenter.description: When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

strictlyNecessary.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
strictlyNecessary.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.description: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

performance.title: Performance Cookies
performance.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

targeting.title: Targeting Cookies
targeting.description: These cookies may be set through our site by us and/or our third-party service providers. They may be used by us and/or our third-party service providers to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites and/or devices. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
